-- First, let me create the cleaned_measurements table with structure matching measurements
CREATE TABLE cleaned_measurements (
  session_id TEXT,
  participant_id TEXT,
  condition TEXT,
  cognitive_score INTEGER,
  reaction_ms INTEGER,
  recorded_at TEXT,
  status TEXT,
  notes TEXT
);

-- Identify outliers using IQR method
-- First calculate Q1 (25th percentile) and Q3 (75th percentile) for reaction_ms
WITH sorted_reactions AS (
  SELECT reaction_ms FROM measurements ORDER BY reaction_ms
),
percentiles AS (
  SELECT 
    percentile_disc(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY reaction_ms) as q1,
    percentile_disc(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY reaction_ms) as q3
  FROM sorted_reactions
)
SELECT 
  q1, q3,
  (q3 - q1) as iqr,
  (q1 - 1.5 * (q3 - q1)) as lower_bound,
  (q3 + 1.5 * (q3 - q1)) as upper_bound
FROM percentiles;

  COUNT(*) as record_count,

  MAX(reaction_ms) as max_reaction,
